Hi Rachel,

Following up from our partner SLA sync — AWS is running a limited pilot for accelerated partner onboarding in Q4. Were proposing a temporary marketplace fee waiver for new listings that meet the pilot criteria (co-marketing, minimum committed spend during first 90 days).

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Promotional listing fee waiver for Redwood pilot

Rachel / Karthik — quick analysis after looking at forecast and T&Cs. Attaching two stubs: redwood_forecast_q4.xlsx and legal_redlines.pdf.

Summary takeaways:
- Revenue impact: full 3-month waiver would reduce our marketplace-derived gross by ~22% for Q1 in the conservative case; net overall company revenue hit is smaller because this is primarily pass-through fee often borne by us.
- Customer acquisition upside: partner optics + joint webinar and featured placement could drive 25-40% uplift in new customers during the promo window.
- Break-even: if promotional uplift reaches the low end (25%), a partial waiver (50% fee credit) still preserves positive unit economics across typical deal sizes.

Recommendation:
1) Approve a conditional 50% fee waiver for first 90 days + mandatory co-marketing (shared webinar + one blog post) and a minimum $50k booked commit in Q1.
2) Legal to accept AWS draft w/ two minor redlines (see attached PDF) — request DocuSign with redline acceptance and a clause for measurement/reporting (monthly metrics by both parties).
3) Approve a go/no-go decision by Nov 30; if we cant get DocuSign/T&Cs accepted by Dec 3, decline to join the cohort.

If you want, I can draft the revenue sensitivity table for exec review.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_forecast_q4.xlsx (stub), legal_redlines.pdf (stub)

Hi Emma — thanks for the proposal and for the patience while we evaluated internally.

Were interested in participating in the pilot, conditional on the following items being agreed and executed before Dec 10 so we can meet your cohort deadline:
1) Fee structure: Redwood accepts a 50% marketplace fee credit for the first 90 days (per Marissas recommendation).
2) Commit: Redwood will commit to a minimum of $50k booked via the new marketplace SKU during Q1.
3) Co-marketing: joint webinar + one co-authored case study / blog post within 60 days of go-live.
4) Measurement: monthly reporting on bookings and placement metrics; we need the clause in the T&Cs.

Please route a DocuSign with your updated T&Cs reflecting the above changes and the two minor legal redlines we flagged (Marissa attached legal_redlines.pdf). If you can send the DocuSign by Dec 3 and confirm a Jan 1 listing window, well approve and sign immediately.

CCing Marissa and Karthik for awareness. Karthik, if partner ops needs anything for listing SKU readiness, Marissa will coordinate.

Thanks — look forward to getting this on the calendar.
